smuggler.label: Smuggler
templates: There's a boat lies {where} after dark. Whiskey no exciseman ever saw, and she'll take goods with no questions.
If you've cargo you'd rather not explain, look {where} once the sun's down.
A lantern shows {where} most nights. Smuggler's boat. You didn't hear it from me.

legends.name: The Lucerne's Last Cargo
lines: Fishermen off Long Island say a lantern bobs where the Lucerne went down in '86. All hands lost, and her captain's strongbox with them.
The Lucerne went down off Long Island with all hands. Some nights there's a light out there, low on the water, where no boat should be.

legends.name: The Quarryman's Payroll
lines: When the quarry company went under in '93, the last payroll never reached the men on Hermit Island. Gold, they say. Nobody's found it.
Ask the old quarrymen about the Hermit Island payroll and watch them go quiet. It vanished the week the company failed.

legends.name: The Dark Light of Minnesota Point
lines: The old light on Minnesota Point's been dark for years. So who's been showing a lantern up the tower on moonless nights?
Men off the night tug swear they've seen signals from the dead light on Minnesota Point. Smugglers, or worse.

legends.name: The Devil's Grotto
lines: A drowned man's journal came ashore once. All it said that anyone could read was 'the third cave, at the dark of the moon.' Devils Island has caves enough.
The sea caves on Devils Island boom like cannon in a northeaster. A smuggler went in one calm night and never came out, so they say.

legends.name: Outer Island's Ghost Net
lines: A fisherman on Outer Island went out one morning and never came back. His nets still come up now and then, with odd things in them.
Nobody fishes the old camp on Outer Island anymore. Not since the nets started coming up full of things no lake ever made.
